responsibility: This autogenerated .opt.urls companion for gcc/config/m68k/m68k-tables.opt is the place where manual URL annotations would be attached to the generated Enum and EnumValue records backing m68k -mcpu=, -march=, and -mtune= option values. Within GCC’s option documentation machinery, it exists to associate generated option-table entries with manual anchors when available; in this revision it is effectively empty, reflecting that no per-enumerator URLs were emitted. It therefore serves documentation-link generation for the option tables rather than defining options or backend behavior itself.
